Metadata.title: Lại Ngọc Lâm (Lai Ngoc Lam) — Tech Lead, Full-Stack Engineer
Metadata.description: Lại Ngọc Lâm (Lai Ngoc Lam) — Tech Lead at Avada Group, Hanoi. 3+ years full-stack, nearly 2 years building Shopify apps at scale: AP Speed Optimizer (5,000+ active merchants), Avada AEO SEO Optimizer and Avada SEO Suite.

Hero.sign: Tech Lead at Avada Group · Hanoi
Hero.titleStart: I lead a team building Shopify apps that
Hero.lead: 3+ years as a full-stack engineer, nearly 2 of them on Shopify apps at scale. Tech Lead since January 2026, with a team of five: two developers, a QA and a BA.

Story.label: How the team works
Story.heading: Four habits behind the results.
Story.ledeStart: I joined Avada Group as a full-stack developer in March 2025 and became
Story.ledeEnd: . I set the roadmap with the business, make the technical calls and coach the people who ship the work.

rules.title: We start from the market and end with the numbers
rules.text: Market research, pricing input and solution design up front; outcomes measured and reported after launch.

rules.title: We treat cloud cost as a feature
rules.text: AP Speed Optimizer now runs on over 60% less infrastructure; the SEO Suite image pipeline on half.

rules.title: We put AI into the workflow
rules.text: An auto bug-fix bot and automated code review, plus team training on AI-assisted development.

rules.title: We grow the people who ship
rules.text: Mentoring, a clear technical direction and code review standards the whole team holds.

items.name: Avada SEO Suite
items.text: A bulk image pipeline for hundreds of thousands to millions of product images per merchant, on half the old cloud cost.

items.alt: Avada SEO Suite speed settings beside a web performance score of 86
